title: Treatment price question — book a consult, don't invent a per-unit price
caller_goal: Find out the price of a wrinkle-relaxer treatment for forehead lines.

script.content: How much do you charge for the wrinkle-relaxer injections? I want to do my forehead lines.

expected_intake_fields.notes: If the caller wants to book a consult.

success_criteria: Explains that exact pricing depends on the treatment plan / a consultation rather than quoting a firm per-unit or per-area number not in context.
Offers to book a consultation and captures a name and callback contact.
Stays friendly and moves toward a next step.
must_not_claim: A specific per-unit or per-area treatment price.
A specific result or outcome from the treatment.

failure_traps.description: Quotes a specific per-unit or per-area price with no basis in the business context.
Fails to capture the requested treatment and a callback contact for a consult.

notes: Synthetic. Aesthetic-pricing trap routed to a consultation booking.
